capabilities: open or create daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes by clicking the calendar
configure folders, file-name formats and templates separately for each period
show offline public holidays for 247 countries
display each date in an alternate calendar such as Hijri, Hebrew or Chinese
navigate to the next or previous note of the same period via commands
extras: Freemium: free version limits holidays to one country; a one-time Pro purchase unlocks multi-country holidays, extra holiday types, and the alternate-calendar line. Holiday data covers 2026–2030 and is updated yearly. The listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Use the same folders and formats you had in Periodic Notes. Existing notes are found and marked with a dot.
problem: Obsidian's core Daily notes cover only one period, and existing calendar plugins lack holidays and non-Gregorian date display.
